design_status: R3 is a design input concretized only by this bounded package; does not supersede current Semantic, SDK or manifest authority.
frozen_decisions: Existing InputRouter/Coordinator/CanvasEditingRuntime remain input/session owners; existing OperationEngine remains sole mutation owner. No async Operation or queued-Up semantics.
Admission, semantic commit, Scene readiness, render submission and qualified completion remain distinct. Presentation backlog alone must not reject a valid next eraser Down.
New dependent queries use the current committed Scene or independently recover it using the existing derived recovery owner; never query old masks.
Retained partial erase feedback is not a Brush ARC contour. Runtime owns active/sealed/replaced identities; Provider remains a resource/presentation owner.

Only actual strictly accepted exact canonical completion can retire the frozen eligible sealed set. A newer exact frame may replace older cancelled draw work per R3-1, without synthesizing old receipts and without clearing a newer gesture.

Common post-commit contract lives in existing Interaction/Composition owners. New valid eraser input and camera input are independent of old exact pixels; document/Scene/visual basis are evaluated separately, not one universal ready flag.

Post-Up camera update may already be accepted while feedback is gated by previous exact Scene generation. Do not label delayed visual submission as input rejection without the public return/error fact.

Navigation may use a current synchronized Scene-derived disposable source/demand before any new exact canonical is submitted. Build a fresh current basis; never relabel lastSubmittedCanonicalFrameState, old pixels or canonical capture as the new Scene.

Old navigation pixels are reusable only with existing full validity or regional unchanged-content proof. Newly erased areas must not reappear. Navigation remains approximate and cannot qualify CanonicalVisible or retire sealed feedback.
Keep actual on-screen content valid while waiting for target capacity; no synchronous GPU waits and no busy spin. Hard surface loss remains distinct from a healthy provider waiting for a buffer.

Current background/clear/transparent/isolation/composition policy must be derived from the same authoritative FramePlan construction inputs as canonical, and stamped to the current synchronized Scene/frame/provider/resource basis. A rendered new exact image is not the authority for these policy facts.

The shared Render owner validates that current composition policy plus existing complete source/order/body equality and conservative mask sampling damage before promoting any unchanged region. Missing proof, body/order/material/resource/background differences or stale identity must safely refuse reuse. No restamping old frame/image into current canonical work.

Pixel differences are not waived by lower timing. Persist actual before/Undo/Redo buffers/snapshots and use existing independent oracle/accepted GPU AA edge policy. Strict raw hash mismatch remains an observation; no new tolerance or difference-derived edge band.

The old fc02 live sweep fixture may establish a real qualified initial Brush handoff, then test deferred erase. Do not restore render/clear in Down to satisfy an obsolete expectation; keep all sweep and commit assertions.

For Brush-Up->immediate partial erase, input Down must not hide the only valid visible Brush source while its pixels are absent from canonical. Logical retention and physical visibility are separate, both must be checked.

During an active edit, an actually successful, validated full-viewport replacement feedback containing the current committed Scene and current active edit may take display ownership and suppress the redundant old layer. This is visual replacement only, not retirement of the Brush identity, CanonicalVisible, commit or durability. A partial/unknown/stale/failed feedback cannot do so. Logical Brush retirement still follows the existing strict qualified canonical completion path.

If no valid replacement is available, keep the previous valid display. A delayed old preview submit/completion cannot re-show a suppressed stale layer or erase the current gesture. Cancel/lost/resize recover via existing owners; no synthetic Brush receipt or global clear.
